name: Extra Tricky Spells
body:
You can hide your spellcasting more often than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Tricky spells class feature, Stealth 10 ranks

Benefit: You can use your tricky spells class feature a number of times per day equal to your arcane trickster class level instead of the normal amount.
